modelspec.observatory.RunFailed.title: RunFailed
modelspec.observatory.RunFailed.description: The event of a run failing, the last of its stream (RunEventBody). A failure is a diagnostic or a runtime error (DESIGN.md § 8.1, diagnostics distinguish user specification errors from runtime failures).

code.description: The diagnostic code that refused the run, such as E-DATA-003 (DESIGN.md § 8.1, M0 codes for `train`); absent for a runtime error, which has no code.

message.description: The failure on one line, the diagnostic's message or the runtime error as `modelspec train` reports it.
